_comment: Copy to config/catalog.json. Keys (e.g. 'laptops', 'beirut') are YOUR names, used as categoryKey / locationKey. olxCategoryId is OLX's category externalID; find ids with `npm run catalog -- categories <text>`, then run `npm run catalog -- fields <id>` to see each category's required fields and choice values, and fill requiredAttributes / attributeMap / valueMap / defaults from it. The category entries below have real ids but their fields are NOT filled in yet. Locations use OLX's numeric location id of an AREA inside a district (level 2): a district alone is rejected. Find ids with `npm run catalog -- locations <text>`; the ones below are from a capture. listingDefaults (optional) applies to every listing: locationId or locationKey for listings without a location, and a descriptionFooter added to every description.
